rules.accepted_credit_types: ACPE-approved providers or Board-approved providers; other courses can be submitted for Board approval via a DELPROS service request
rules.new_licensee_rule: First renewal: 1.25 hours for each month between initial licensure and the biennial renewal date.
rules.audit_note: Random audits. CE is entered in the DELPROS CE Tracker; documents are uploaded only if selected (CPE Monitor log for ACPE courses, certificates/agendas for others).

topics.who: All pharmacists: distribution/dispensing/delivery of controlled substances, or recognizing impairment and dependency from abuse of controlled substances
Immunizing pharmacists: administering injectable medications, biologicals and adult immunizations

rules.notes: Licensure period Oct 1 – Sep 30 of even years. Immunizing pharmacists also need 2 hours on administering injectable medications, biologicals and adult immunizations. Live-hour minimum not confirmed (regulation text not readable).
